item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are clear about the stakes: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must stop it from being built.

2. We reject a future in which a race to build superintelligence ends in mass death. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will kill at least a billion people. We call for a ban on its development.

3. We cannot protect humanity while permitting the development of the technology that will destroy it. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We demand prevention, not damage control.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We face a stark choice: stop the development of superintelligent AI, or let the race to build it end in catastrophe. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We will not treat those lives as an acceptable price for technological progress. We work toward a ban on superintelligence because prevention is the only responsible course. We need policy that stops this race, not promises to manage its aftermath. In this newsletter, we explain what we are fighting for and how we can build the public resolve to protect our future.
